notes.title: A Taste of Greece Update | Greek DLC, Customer Reaction Emojis and Fixes [1.11]
notes.content:
A Taste of Greece DLC
Greek food is one of the most popular cuisines and is enjoyed around the world. From delicious Gyros to tasty Moussaka, Greece offers something for everyone! This expansion adds some of the best (and most popular) Greek-inspired meals there are. You also gain access to Olive Plaza, an infamous site where a historical duel took place between the then King of the Island, Theo III and the Leader of the Pirate Invaders, Captain Otis Glacier, also known as the Cold Captain, attracting many tourists to the island every year, acting as the perfect site for you to set up your Grub Truck and serve some delicious Greek street food!



[img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3828940/1815fe6f7218c79e3fcfd1311768f3c6aaf03ab2/ss_1815fe6f7218c79e3fcfd1311768f3c6aaf03ab2.1920x1080.jpg?t=1757061095"]
Hungry yet? Purchase DLC here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828940/Grub_Truck__A_Taste_of_Greece/"][/dynamiclink]
   
Customer Reaction Emojis  
Customers have feelings as well you know! 



We've made it much easier to know your customers' opinions on how you performed by displayed emoji's above their head when an action happens that affects their mood.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/e26511b2d5b96378032595ba2f01352a13c31455.jpg"]


New Free Content
To celebrate the addition of the A Taste of Greece expansion, we have added a heatwave event where customers are more likely to purchase bottles of water - so tock up! And what's the last thing you want to think about in a heatwave? Rugs! Well, that's exactly what we've added!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/59c956c51aef78d64274554f6fefc2436c40437a.jpg"]


Quality of Life Improvements
Version 1.11 brings some of the largest bug fixes that have been long needed for Grub Truck as well as a list of quality of life improvements to make your gameplay even more exciting! Before you ask, yes, AI should no longer slide after using Build Mode...



Happy Grubbing!

notes.title: Version 1.7 | Food Gets Cold, Christmas Event & Improvements!
notes.content:
FOOD GETS COLD!

As highly recommended by. multiple people, hot food & drink now cools down after it's been cooked/poured, bringing a greater focus to serving food efficiently and making use of appliances like the Plate Warmer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f28171cfbbe206d5ba45727f2a4fa645884b372b.png

Customer Rating Effect

If you serve a customer cold food they will leave a pretty large negative rating for your food truck. 

Keep in mind that any effect that influencers and critics give you are multiplied whether they're positive or negative!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/1ec628ea67190a245c03a5f10d7239d05871ad31.png

Tips

[olist]
 Try to plan ahead by previewing what the customer will order by hovering your mouse over them in the queue.
 Get yourself the plate warmer and place hot food & drink on it to keep it warm whilst you prep everything else.
 Leave your items to cook that little bit longer to give yourself more time to get the other items ready, just make sure you don't let it burn!
 Leave jacket potatoes in the oven! The potato oven keeps the potatoes perfectly warm and they won't cool down or burn.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/28640af1395d4d62fc3f78e5ddc378639d6261e2.png


CHRISTMAS EVENT

Who doesn't love Christmas? The local residents of Chestnut Ridge certainly do! Every location has seen plenty of snowfall and the locals have been out building snowmen, placing Christmas Trees and hiding presents, can you find them all?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/12474186333f732e4325c8a7521448cc2a89220d.png

notes.title: Version 1.6 | New Menu, Attach Objects & Pumpkin Pie!
notes.content:
NEW MENU

As highly requested, 1.6 brings you a brand new menu that is much easier to use!

Drag & Drop

The old, ugly dropdown system has gone! Say hello to the new drag and drop menu system. Simply chose the slot you want to modify, drag your chosen item into the slot and set your price!

You can change, remove and modify the price of your menu items at any time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/30eeacd603c7a00f2078ced1da2b5d746e378961.gif

Unlockable Slots

You can now unlock more menu item slots the more experience you gain as a Grub Truck chef. Ontop of this, there are now a lot more slots available to occupy with menu items, allowing you to have complete control over your menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/8c23beb7a5888bef7c19abc8527274c31e44a200.gif

Menu Navigation

Not only does the new menu just look 1000% better (accurate statistic), it is also much easier to navigate, with the whole menu being scrollable, quick action buttons taking you to parts of the menu and all menu slots showing you the icon, name and set price of each slot within a single box!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f78dd78608bd8569df0d66647c5318227e3cb3bc.gif


ATTACHED OBJECTS MOVE TOGETHER!

As the title suggests, objects now attached to each other and can be moved together, so you will no longer have to worry about the concerning floating knife block that was ontop of the fridge!

Note: In order to get previously placed objects to become attached, you will need to move them in Build Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/b503b0bccd733fdbcf13989f732b64f010db3145.gif


NEW MAIN MENU ITEM!

Halloween is quickly approaching, and to celebrate, here's a spooky main to add to your menu: The Pumpkin Pie!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/549b0a44b796c64d4a4c7f371de826a7b09e77bc.png


MINI FRIDGE!

You can now get a mini fridge that doesn't store much, but it can be hung on walls, give you optimal floor space for your Grub Truck! There is also a new sauce box variant to add some variety to your trucks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/f8008013df995417a33ca78b792436f50aac2f65.png


2 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS!

For you achievement hunters out there, there has been two new achievements added: Size Matters & Queue-tastrophe!


Happy Grubbing!

notes.title: Version 1.5 | Manager Improvements, Simulator Radio, Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
MANAGER IMPROVEMENTS

The long awaited improvements to managers is finally here! Here's a brief look at what's changed!

Manager Budgets

You can now assign budgets to managers for them to buy stock with. You can also toggle whether they can use your personal stock to save money.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/d79c19ebdfc17044e9fcb1b16b1a7fb9f0dea400.png

Manager Locations & Signature Dishes

You can now assign locations to each manager and their truck. This also means that things such as signature dishes and location business now all effect every manager.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/6bd58e8541e33f5c3f95d63126a3075cda12a77a.png

Manager Reports

You can now see a breakdown of each truck's info including stats such as: appliance count, average appliance level, whether the signature dish is correct, the manager's wage, the average menu price etc. Most importantly, you can now see a breakdown of what the manager has sold in the previous day, displaying how much income they made and how much they spent on stock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/57d3a0657baa2bdc41bf35384a29ab69003beb78.png


SIMULATOR RADIO

I'm super excited about this one! 

We've teamed up with SimuatlorRadio (the team behind the radio in games like Euro Truck Simulator & Farming Simulator), to bring you live music through the HelixHarmony Radio object, which can be placed anywhere in your truck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/10e8b72cf4ffc1a1c26f5c70c173fd05c3755484.png


PREVIEW CUSTOMER ORDERS

As suggested by you guys, you can now preview the orders of customers in your queue. Simply hover your mouse over a customer to see what they are likely to order. The higher your level, the more items you can see in the order bubble.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/1de249f446a89cf330951e1b0ff171c4a9b7c08f.png


NEW TRUCK

There's a new truck in town! 

The Nomad MunchMobile offers a different take on the serving window position to give you even more floor space to play with. How will you layout your interior with this new take? There is also a variant for this truck called the Beachgoer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/3bac2671bdd4e71d9325d23969c94ee645f76203.png


2 NEW CUSTOMERS & 2 NEW MANAGERS

2 new residents have moved into Chestnut Ridge! Say hello to the Lawyers. They may be quite picky in what they order and will only turn up in the more built up locations, but they're sure to spend more money than most!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/9480906507a76b885ca27fc61962d84e782dcaa7.png

Thanks to the two winners of the August 2024 Manager Competition, there are 2 new managers available! Hire Timothée Chowmein or Hans Grubber today! 

Join our Discord server to get involved in future competitions! 
https://discord.gg/eMVsRU7PdF


OTHER STUFF

Along with this update, there's been a tutorial added explaining how to use managers, manager profits have been added to the end of day receipt for a speedier viewing & customer lose patience if you make mistakes in their order if it is later on in the day. Ontop of this, there's been a bunch of fixes and a lot of changes/improvements such as truck storage being collated all into one. 

Check out the full list in the changelog below.

Happy Grubbing!

With this updates comes a new truck for you to add to your arsenal. The Nomad Explorer, a recently converted family caravan. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/dd1b9145d5783ce39cd0338e7140374cba3c29cb.png

Due to its shape, it offers some extra space, particularly at the front and back of the truck for you to tuck some appliances or decorations away in. And with its huge serving counter, customers are sure to flood to your new truck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/75a3868a2858acf8c43be4d66005d85d26a88d11.png


Umbrellas & Water Trails

As per a recommendation on our TikTok, customers (and people passing by) now carry umbrellas! Whenever it begins to rain, they will take them out of their pockets. Furthermore, you will now see a trail of water following everyone’s footsteps whenever the weather is wet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842222/8f2bd5daa7257adf1c922b082fab094122780d3c.png

Menu Rating

The menu attractiveness feature has been integrated into the rating system so that you can now see the direct effect of your menu changes on your Grub Truck’s rating. Be sure to feature each location’s signature dish to get a boost to your rating and remember - the more options customers can choose from, the happier they are and the more potential customers you can serve!
